# AWA editorial redesign and free-store campaign

> For agentic workers: implement this plan task by task, with a code review before publication.

**Goal:** Redesign AWA's agency pages, launch a transparent free online store offer, add three original English guides and sitewide article recommendations, then publish through the existing GitHub deployment.

**Architecture:** Retain the static HTML and existing `_tools/build.py` source generator. Shared visual rules live in `signal.css`; dedicated campaign and journal sources are generated by `_tools/commerce_pages.py`. Preserve existing Worker-backed brief and AI-test APIs, portfolio demos, analytics boundaries and user changes.

**Tech stack:** HTML, CSS, vanilla JavaScript, Python static generator; GitHub Pages, main branch/root, with the existing Cloudflare edge services.

## Tasks

- [x] Inspect tracked changes, source templates, page types, existing form contracts and deployment. Record pre-existing missing clips and exclude those deletions from this release.
- [x] Create graphite, chalk and signal-orange art direction; generate three custom images, optimise into versioned local WebP assets and document prompts.
- [x] Add `signal.css` with responsive shared shell, editorial grids, service styling, campaign components, article layouts and reduced-motion rules. Rebuild the homepage hero; preserve its agent-test GET contract in a separate readable section. Place the free-store promo after services, separate from the hero.
- [x] Extend `_tools/build.py` to inject the shared stylesheet, navigation, footer and article recommendations. Include new pages in its page registry and generator. Update the online-store service source so Neocart is clearly separate from custom platform projects.

Existing briefing accepts `service=online-stores` and a free-store note. No new billing or backend integration.
- [x] Generate `journal.html` and three substantial original en-AU articles covering free-store models, operating costs and launch preparation. Include visible date, author, canonicals, social metadata, structured data, source provenance and reciprocal recommendations.
- [x] Update sitemap and discovery documents. Ensure the existing pilot offer is explicitly separate from the zero-licence campaign; do not imply stacked discounts.
- [x] Run `_tools/build.py`; check reproducibility, static links/IDs/structured data, responsive widths 320–1440, navigation, archive filters, article links, cost maths, brief prefill and no-JavaScript access. Test backend errors with intercepted fixtures; never send a real test brief.
- [ ] Review the diff against the user's scope, fix material findings, commit selected files, push the existing production branch and verify the published domain.

## Assumptions and boundaries

- AWA remains an Australian-English agency site. The user confirmed A$999 one-time setup plus GST on 19 October 2026. No invented currency conversion, hosting tariff or tax rate.
- The delivered shop can be configured in English; the optional external Neocart planner currently uses Hungarian and must be labeled. Confirm delivered language in each written scope.
- No invented offices, staff, reviews, sales results, limited stock or guaranteed launch dates.
- Remote art generation provides decorative assets only; application data stays within existing form/API contracts. AI-generated editorial product scenes are not represented as client work.
- Risks: generated HTML must stay aligned with its sources; CSS must not change demos or API tools; links must keep working without animation or JavaScript. Future updates run the generator and the regression audit before publication.
